name: Pleria - The Royal Emblem
source:
Pleria is a proof of succession to the throne in distant future imaginary kingdom and it was stolen by rebel army. Princess Miria asks her cousin Ariane to search for Pleria. Ariane takes priest apprentice Rena with him and sets on a journey. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-august-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在遥远未来的虚构王国里，“王家徽记”是王位继承的凭证，却被叛军盗走。米莉亚公主请表亲阿里安寻回这件信物。阿里安带上见习祭司蕾娜，踏上旅程。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-august-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
